new_exact_reduction.strict_convexity: F''(lambda)=1/[lambda(1-lambda)]-(m/2)(Delta/q(lambda))^2. Since 1/[lambda(1-lambda)]>=4 and (m/2)(Delta/q_u)^2=1.65747177395, F''(lambda)>2.3425 throughout (0,1).
